warning: Red: waters closed to waterfowl hunting. Amber: Category I areas (lottery permit only), Category II areas (open only on their listed days) and waters where waterfowl hunting is barred within 200 yards of a residence. Not drawn: Lake Succession (closed), the cove southeast of the Indian Bluff recreation site (closed), the Kershaw County part of Lake Wateree (closed — inside the amber Lake Wateree outline), Bear Creek in Lancaster County, the coves east of St. Julien Subdivision Extension and Cypress Shores Marina, the water by Santee Cooper Resort and the Congaree–Wateree confluence to Poplar Creek (all 200 yards). Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: SCDNR 2026–27 regulations: Waterfowl Hunting on Certain Bodies of Water; WMA Regulations 10.x; Waterfowl on Management Areas (Category I and II table).
